Heard Mr. M.A. Mondal, learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. By this application under section 438 Cr.P.C., the petitioner namely, Shanur Page No.# 2/3 Alom @ Shahanur Alom is praying for pre-arrest bail as he is apprehending arrest in connection with Shanur Alom @ Shahanur Alom vs The State Of Assam on 19 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78353946/

4. I have considered the submissions at the bar.
5. The allegations against the petitioner is that the victim had a love affair with the petitioner for last two years.
The petitioner is an Army Personnel and whenever he used to visit home, he used to take the victim to different places and also promised to marry her and developed physical relationship with her.
The petitioner usually stays in Delhi and he used to talk to the victim over phone frequently.

A week prior to 23.11.2022, the petitioner came on leave and met the victim at B.H.B.
College, Sorupeta and promise to marry the victim.
On 21.11.2022 when victim was proceeding to the College the petitioner called her over phone and asked her to meet him at Chowk.
Thereafter, the petitioner along with two other accused persons named in the FIR brought the victim to Dhaba and committed rape upon her.
Thereafter, the victim was taken to another Dhaba and there again the petitioner has also made physical relationship with the victim against her will.

After leaving the Dhaba, the petitioner however refused to marry the victim and when she compelled the petitioner to marry her, the petitioner along with another two accused assaulted the victim and they abandoned the victim at the place of occurrence.
6. It is submitted at the bar that it is not possible to commit rape in a 'Dhaba'.
It has been falsely alleged that the petitioner promised to marry the victim.
The petitioner has prayed for interim bail because he is an Army Personnel and in the event of his arrest, he may be terminated from service.
The victim is a major and it is alleged that the victim tried to exercise pressure on the petitioner to marry her.
The allegation of rape is absolutely false.
The petitioner Page No.# 3/3 has no earlier criminal antecedent.

7. Call for the case diary along with the statement of the victim under section 164 Cr.P.C, fixing 09.08.2023.
8.

In the interim and in the event of arrest, the petitioner namely, Shanur Alom @ Shahanur Alom,
shall be enlarged on bail on furnishing a bail bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rupees Fifty Thousand) with two local suitable surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority, in connection with Patacharkuchi P.S. Case No. 201/2023,(G.R. Case No. 216/2023) under sections 417/406/376 of I.P.C 8.
